partition: All supported cells with c=P_A^2/Q_A >= 0.001 sum(c) become singletons regardless of risk or outcomes. Historical event cells above 0.000001 sum(c) also become singletons. Remaining support keeps the parent's risk-by-log-LR partition.
allocation: Project training-only per-action Beta planning ranges through G=c/C; maximize Bernoulli variance over each projected range. Minimize sum(C_h^2 v_upper_h/n_h) by exact integer marginal gains. Preserve equal-arm counts for any historically event-bearing stratum; other strata retain at least half their equal-arm counts, with an absolute two-draw minimum.
comparison: Two independent batches, same partition and 256 draws/state/arm. Within a batch both arms use the same stratum-action/native prefixes. Shared physical draws are simulated once and are never counted as independent replications.
budget: 33792 logical draws, at most 33792 unique native continuations. Counts, actions, seeds and all source cases locked before outcomes. No outcome-dependent extension or extra batch.
scope: Fixed training-bank J measurement. Planning ranges are a working model, not evaluation confidence intervals. Original state target, teacher Q_A, NDE, production Q_S and PPO are unchanged.
